mission_understanding: Deploy Wazuh SIEM Manager on Proxmox. Previous attempt on Debian 12 LXC failed due to missing sudo and dependencies during the wazuh-install script. A new Ubuntu 22.04 LXC template has been downloaded. Need to create the LXC, install dependencies, and run the wazuh-install.sh script.

execution_steps.action_description: Create Ubuntu 22.04 LXC container (VMID 102) on Proxmox using the downloaded template in local-lvm.
execution_steps.expected_outcome: LXC container 102 is created and started.

execution_steps.action_description: Install required dependencies (curl, sudo, gnupg, apt-transport-https, lsb-release) inside the LXC container.
Download and execute the Wazuh installation script (wazuh-install.sh -a) inside the LXC container.
execution_steps.expected_outcome: Wazuh Manager is fully installed and admin passwords are outputted.

safety_constraints: Do not delete existing storage pools.
